result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection on a one-way street with sidewalks but no marked pedestrian infrastructure. There are no visible crosswalks, curb ramps, or traffic control signs at the immediate corner, creating an environment where pedestrians must navigate vehicle traffic without designated protection.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crosswalk
hazards.description: No painted markings to indicate a pedestrian crossing area at the intersection, reducing driver awareness.

hazards.name: Missing curb ramps
hazards.description: The sidewalk ends at a vertical curb with no ramp, creating a significant barrier for people with mobility aids or strollers.
hazards.location_in_image: Corner of the sidewalk in the center-right

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked vehicle
hazards.description: The silver SUV is parked very close to the corner, potentially blocking sightlines between drivers and pedestrians entering the roadway.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian space and improve visibility.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install tactile, sloped curb ramps at the corner to ensure accessibility for all users.

interventions.title: Corner Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near the intersection to improve sightlines for both pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: The image depicts a residential one-way street intersection that lacks essential pedestrian safety features such as marked crosswalks and curb ramps.
